source.claim_boundary: Public corpus; no novelty/withheld-test assurance or independent operator.
source.data_modification: Full source file, README and license copied unchanged; extracted JSON level rows are a derived representation.
source.selection_rule: First lexicographic .txt file in hard/; first three semicolon-numbered records in file order. No filtering or replacement.

budget.wall_clock_scope: Board parsing and solver including heuristic preparation. Separate final replay and serialization overhead reported in total_elapsed_seconds, not search budget.
budget.expansion_definition: Popped non-stale non-terminal exact (sorted boxes, player position) state whose successors are considered.
budget.termination: First wall-clock/deadline or expansion limit; periodic deadline checks in reachability, successor and heuristic loops.

baseline: Uniform-cost legal-push search, zero heuristic, no static pruning.
comparison: Same graph, A* with reverse-push minimum goal assignment and static dead-square pruning. No fitting or target-specific rules.
precommit_rule: No selected level solving before all lock/data/code artifacts are published and exact-readback verified on main. No code/data/budget/selector/scoring changes after results.
comparison_rule: Report paired per-level results, solved counts and expansions. Support only bounded operational benefit if comparison solves at least as many locked levels, no invalid solution is accepted, and it strictly improves at least one paired solved outcome or expansion count without worsening any jointly solved level's expansion count. Otherwise report no support/negative/unevaluable, with no task removal. Do not infer population significance from3 levels.
judge: Separate replay.py, no imports from solver graph; invalid solution never accepted.

sanity.full_repository_local_pytest: Not run; pytest unavailable in runtime. Protected exact-head remote CI retained.

environment.dependency_policy: Python standard library only; same interpreter/process environment for both methods.

claim_boundary: External public corpus with mechanically checked behavior, operated in this same session. Not independent evaluation, fresh withheld-test assurance, previously unseen-task assurance, learned generalization, production performance or AGI.
